home.emptyBody: An instance is one Minecraft setup: a version, a loader and its own worlds.

image.title: Change image

manual.title: Download these manually

restore.menu: Go back to how it was…

team_server_too_big.message: Your team's plan has no room for a server this size.

server_name_taken.message: Your team already has a server with that name.

invalid_team_server.message: The server couldn't be created with these choices.

offline_name_invalid.message: Player names must be 3–16 letters, numbers or underscores.

accounts_damaged.fix: Remove accounts.json from the data folder and add your accounts again.

offline_locked.message: Offline accounts are only available in development builds.
offline_locked.fix: Sign in with Microsoft to play.

microsoft_awaiting_approval.message: Minecraft hasn't approved Perland Launcher yet, so it turned the sign-in down. Your Microsoft account is fine: you'll be able to play as soon as it's approved.

microsoft_not_configured.message: Microsoft sign-in isn't set up in this build.

microsoft_sign_in_again.message: Sign in with Microsoft again to keep playing.

minecraft_not_owned.message: This Microsoft account doesn't own Minecraft: Java Edition.
minecraft_not_owned.fix: Sign in with the account that bought it, or get it at minecraft.net.

minecraft_no_profile.message: This account owns Minecraft but hasn't picked a player name yet.
minecraft_no_profile.fix: Set one up at minecraft.net, then sign in again.

xbox_no_profile.message: This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile yet.
xbox_no_profile.fix: Sign in once at xbox.com to create one, then try again.

xbox_region_blocked.message: Xbox Live isn't available in your country, so this account can't sign in.

xbox_age_verification.message: This account needs adult verification on xbox.com before it can sign in.

xbox_child_account.message: This is a child account. An adult needs to add it to a Microsoft family first.

microsoft_rate_limited.message: Microsoft is getting too many sign-ins right now. Try again in a minute.

disk_io.message: Couldn't read or write a launcher file.
disk_io.fix: Check that there's free disk space and that the launcher folder isn't read-only.

disk_write_failed.fix: Check that there's free disk space and that the launcher folder isn't read-only.

download_no_url.message: This file has no download address.

download_corrupt.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, the file on the server may be broken.

download_restarted.message: The download had to start over.

host_trouble.fix: Try again in a few minutes.

connection_dropped.message: The connection dropped during a download.
connection_dropped.fix: Check your internet connection and try again.

http_client_failed.message: The launcher couldn't start its network connection.

offline.message: You seem to be offline, and this hasn't been downloaded before.
offline.fix: Connect to the internet and try again.

unsafe_game_data.message: Minecraft's file list contains something unsafe, so it was skipped.

library_unverifiable.message: Couldn't check that a downloaded file is genuine.

minecraft_version_not_found.fix: Pick a version from the list.

mojang_mismatch.message: Mojang sent a different version than the one asked for.

no_asset_index.message: {{version}} is missing its list of game assets.

natives_extract_failed.fix: Close any running Minecraft and try again.

version_in_use.message: Another copy of this Minecraft version is running.

archive_invalid.fix: Press Play again to download it again.

instance_damaged.message: The settings file of “{{id}}” is damaged.
instance_damaged.fix: Delete the instance and create it again.

instance_busy.message: Stop the game before changing this instance.

memory_out_of_range.message: Memory must be between {{min}} and {{max}} MB.

java_unavailable.message: There's no official Java ({{component}}) for this computer.
java_unavailable.fix: Choose a Java installation in the instance settings.

java_start_failed.fix: Set Java back to automatic in the instance settings.

java_path_missing.fix: Pick Java again in the instance settings, or set it back to automatic.

java_test_failed.message: That doesn't look like a working Java.
java_test_failed.fix: Pick the java program inside a Java installation's bin folder.

jvm_args_unclosed_quote.message: A quote in the Java arguments isn't closed.
jvm_args_unclosed_quote.fix: Add the closing quote, or remove the opening one.

jvm_arg_not_option.message: “{{arg}}” isn't a Java option. Each argument starts with a dash.
jvm_arg_not_option.fix: Remove it, or add the dash it's missing.

jvm_arg_not_allowed.message: “{{arg}}” can't be used here. The launcher sets the class path, the main class and how Java starts.
jvm_arg_not_allowed.fix: Remove it from the Java arguments.

jvm_args_memory.message: Memory is set with the slider, not in the Java arguments.
jvm_args_memory.fix: Remove it and move the memory slider instead.

jvm_args_too_long.message: The Java arguments are too long (over {{max}} characters).
jvm_args_too_long.fix: Remove the arguments you don't need.

no_game_arguments.message: {{version}} doesn't say how to start the game.

game_files_missing.fix: Press Play again to repair the instance.

crash_out_of_memory.fix: Give it more memory and press Play again.

crash_graphics_driver.message: Your graphics driver crashed the game.
crash_graphics_driver.fix: Update your graphics driver, restart your computer and press Play again.

crash_java_too_old.message: This game needs Java {{required}} or newer.
crash_java_too_old.fix: Switch to a newer Java and press Play again.

crash_java_too_new.message: This version of Minecraft needs an older Java.
crash_java_too_new.fix: Use the recommended Java and press Play again.

crash_mod_missing_dependency.fix: Add it and press Play again.

crash_mods_clash.fix: Turn one of them off and press Play again.

crash_mod_wrong_version.message: {{mod}} is made for a different version of Minecraft.
crash_mod_wrong_version.fix: Turn it off, or get the version made for this game.

crash_mod_failed.message: {{mod}} broke while the game was loading.
crash_mod_failed.fix: Turn it off and press Play again.

crash_mod_file_damaged.fix: Turn it off and download it again.

version_invalid.fix: Pick a version from the list.

loader_version_not_found.fix: Pick a loader version from the list.

loader_installer_invalid.message: The mod loader's installer couldn't be read.
loader_installer_invalid.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, pick another loader version.

loader_too_old.message: This loader version is too old for the launcher.
loader_too_old.fix: Pick a newer Minecraft version, or another loader.

loader_processor_failed.message: Setting up the mod loader failed.
loader_processor_failed.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the details and ask for help.

loader_output_corrupt.message: A file the mod loader built came out damaged.

meta_cache_missing.message: A saved download list is missing.

meta_not_found.message: A version list wasn't found on the server.

meta_checksum.message: A downloaded version list was damaged.

meta_unexpected.message: A server sent data the launcher doesn't understand.

settings_damaged.message: Your launcher settings couldn't be read, so the defaults are in use.
settings_damaged.fix: Set your preferences again in Settings.

log_write_stopped.message: The game log stopped being saved to disk.
log_write_stopped.fix: Check free disk space. The game keeps running.

diagnostics_path_invalid.message: Diagnostics are saved as a .zip file.

share_path_invalid.message: Shared instances are saved as a .mrpack file.
share_path_invalid.fix: Pick a file name that ends in .mrpack.

free_server_mods_not_on_modrinth.message: Free servers only run mods from Modrinth.

share_too_large.message: This is too big to share as one file.
share_too_large.fix: Leave out worlds, or large files.

mod_not_jar.message: Only .jar files can be added as mods.

mod_name_invalid.message: That isn't a mod file name.

pack_not_found.fix: Check the link and try again.

pack_link_invalid.message: That doesn't look like a pack link.
